insights.text: If you put a bed down by zilyana you can home tele when you get kuldras extraction unlocked instead of resetting. Cuts down the load time and you don't have to tele back to zilly either. Just home tele then talk to zilly, hit 1 hit 4 boom

I can't speak for certain about the dragonwilds team, I played 2 weeks on early access release beat elvarg and didn't touch it til 1.0 release. But I'm assuming they will leave some of the fun in for us. This makes the game more fun, especially for people who like to speedrun/break stuff
